conceptPrompts.A: Use case: ui-mockup. Creature Chronicles equipment window concept, landscape 1536x1024. Reference image is the approved live equipment gallery STYLE REFERENCE. Match the sharp anime-painterly sunlit alpine ranch workbench background, warm ivory parchment, delicate brass botanical borders, forest green buttons, clean serif headings. This is ORIGINAL concept art, not Epic Seven assets. Text stays legible, no menu scrolling, all actions inside frame, no portrait redesign. Present a single coherent UI screen with a small inset of an upgrade result. Use only these known example items: current Field Gloves, Rare, Power C, +0, main Physical Power +5, substats Accuracy +2 and Speed +2; selected Practice Wraps, Common, Power D, +0, main Physical Power +3, no starting substats. Keep rarity, power and enhancement distinct. Equipping selected wraps breaks Swift from4/4 to3/4 and adds Striker1/4; do not invent a price to equip. Upgrade review reveals ONLY main-stat preview and exact Gold fee, random substat is a sealed mystery. Upgrade result reveals an actual rolled substat only after payment. No stars, gearscore, crafting failure, hidden costs or random future stat previews. Label 'Concept · illustrative layout'. Title 'A · Compare Ledger'. Large centered parchment with header Compare equipment; recipient Willow chip top right. Two equal elegant cards, Current and Selected, with distinct hand-painted green gloves and linen wraps, rarity/power/+0 badges, mainstat row and four substat slots. Beneath them a compact strip 'Swift 4/4 →3/4 · Bonus lost' and 'Striker 0/4 →1/4 · In progress'. Three clear tabs Item stats / Creature impact / Upgrade. Footer Back, Blacksmith, Find source, green Review equip. Lower-right small inset receipt titled Upgrade complete with real example mainstat Physical Power5→6 and 'No milestone this level · Substats unchanged'; a modest botanical golden halo surrounds the glove icon. Keep clean and purposeful. Show a small wax-sealed mystery emblem in Upgrade tab label area but no future numeric substat.
